title: Fall with gravity
prompt: Gravity adds gravity pixels per second to the robot's falling speed every second, and down is positive. Return the vertical speed vy after one frame. From 0 with gravity 980, a 0.1 s frame gives 98.
starter:
func solve(vy, gravity, delta) -> float:
	return vy

tests.name: From rest, 0.1 s of gravity is 98
A jump upward slows, then turns down

solution:
func solve(vy, gravity, delta) -> float:
	return vy + gravity * delta
